skill_name: Develop a strong brand identity for a new tech start-up.
workflow: Develop a brand identity that conveys the company’s values and mission. Make sure this identity is unique and reflects a modern, professional image. Have a consistent design and color scheme that is recognizable and memorable. Utilize visuals and other creative elements to communicate the company’s identity in a clear, concise and interesting way.
